name: The unyoked mind (ayukta manas)
description: In the chariot simile: one without discriminating understanding, whose mind is always unyoked, has uncontrolled senses like bad horses, is impure, does not reach that place and goes to saṃsāra (Kaṭha 1.3.5, 1.3.7).

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.
